creator: cjvnjde
title: cjvnjde's Glove80 Dvorak v11
notes: Version 11 of cjvnjde's personal Glove80 layout. Dvorak uses TailorKey-style bilateral home-row mods with per-finger timings. The Magic layer can toggle plain Dvorak, plain QWERTY, and a Cyrillic transliteration layer with Russian letters plus Ukrainian additions. Cyrillic digraphs use held rolling combos; reverse order also works. Combo capacity is raised to seven shared combos per key for the Cyrillic mappings. Dvorak is implemented in keyboard firmware, so keep the host OS input layout set to US QWERTY. Emoji layer and activation match Sunaku's Glorious Engrammer mapping. Left thumb arrows are replaced by Clipboard-layer access, Parang Left, Parang Right, and Emoji access. Clipboard layer contains only Cut, Copy, and Paste on right half. Unused Lower and Symbol keys are transparent.
